faq: Can you edit a site built with Wix ADI or a template?
Yes. We work in the regular editor on templates and ADI sites. If a request fights the template's design, we say so and offer a cleaner way to get a similar result.
Will my site go offline while you edit?
No. Changes are made in the editor and only go live when we publish, which we do after you approve them. The live site stays as it is until then.
Can you add a feature Wix does not have built in?
Often through the Wix App Market or a small embed. For anything bigger, such as custom databases or logic, our Velo and CMS service is the better fit and we will point you there.
What if I am not happy with an edit?
Tell us and we adjust it within your included revisions. We also keep a restore point in your site history, so any change can be rolled back.
desc:
Wix design edits are targeted changes to a site you already have, from a fixed phone layout to a new section or page. Ecom Swift LLC makes them in your own editor, checks each on phone and desktop, and publishes only after you approve.

## What are Wix design edits?

Wix design edits are changes to the look and layout of an existing site without rebuilding it. Typical jobs include moving a section, swapping a banner, restyling buttons, correcting spacing, fixing the mobile view, adding a gallery or pricing block, or creating a new page that matches your existing style.

They suit owners who like the site overall but have a list of things that bother them. You send the list, we work through it, and the rest of the site stays as it is.

## Why do small layout problems matter?

Visitors judge a site quickly, and small flaws add up. A button that overlaps text on a phone, an image that is cropped badly, a menu item that leads nowhere or a section with uneven spacing all suggest carelessness. Some visitors will not trust a business whose own site looks unfinished.

There is also a practical side. Wix has separate desktop and mobile layouts, and a change made for one can break the other. Many owners hesitate to touch the editor because of this, and problems remain for months. A careful edit pass clears the backlog in one go.

## How good edits affect your site's results

Cleaner layouts make pages easier to read and use. When the call to action is aligned, readable and easy to tap, more visitors reach the next step. When a pricing table or gallery shows your offer clearly, fewer people need to write in just to ask basic questions.

Edits also protect what you have already built. Keeping fonts, colors and spacing consistent means new pages look like part of the same business. We do not promise a specific increase in enquiries, because that depends on traffic and offer, but removing visible friction gives visitors a better chance of acting.

## What a careful Wix edit includes

- A restore point in your site history before any change is made.
- Text, image and button changes made in the same style as the rest of the page.
- Header, banner, menu and footer updates that stay consistent across pages.
- Spacing and alignment fixes so sections line up on a grid.
- New sections such as a gallery, a pricing table or an FAQ.
- New pages that reuse your fonts, colors and button styles.
- Mobile view reviewed section by section, with overlaps and hidden elements fixed.
- Image sizes checked so edits do not slow pages down.
- A preview for your approval before publishing.
- A short list of what changed.

## How we work

You send a numbered list of changes, ideally with screenshots or arrows showing what you mean. We confirm the list and count it against your package, then save a restore point and make the edits in your editor.

The Basic package covers a few quick fixes on text, images, buttons or a banner. The Standard package handles more edits, including one new section such as a gallery, pricing or FAQ, plus menu and footer changes. The Premium package covers a larger set, up to three new pages in your style and a rebuilt mobile layout where needed. Your site stays online while we work, and we publish after you approve.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Write each change as one clear instruction.
- Send screenshots with notes on the problem.
- Say which device you saw the problem on.
- Approve the preview before publishing.
- Keep a list for a second round if more ideas appear.

**Avoid:**
- Mixing a redesign into a list of small edits.
- Asking for features Wix does not support natively without discussing them first.
- Editing the same page yourself while we work on it.
- Sending vague requests like "make it nicer".
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A business owner with a Wix site that looks fine on desktop but messy on a phone.
- Someone whose site was made with a template or Wix ADI and needs it tailored to their brand.
- A shop or studio that wants a new gallery, pricing table or page without hiring a full design team.
- A person who has tried the editor, got stuck on alignment, and would rather hand it over.

## What we need from you

Send the site address, your list of changes and any images or text for new sections. We work in your own account, and you add us as a collaborator or team member, so we never need your password. If you already have brand fonts and colors, send them, or we match what the site uses today.
